0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, on a four-game losing streak, 14th in the East and 4 games back in the Central) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (5-1, winners of two straight, 1st in the Atlantic). Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring) and is listed as day-to-day with a game-time decision for Dailyn Swain (back soreness), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and the most recent meeting was a 157-137 Philadelphia win in Philadelphia on March 25, 2026.
